pathAssistantSteps.info:
STAGE 0 – On Dashboard: Businesses that are going to trade in the next three months

-         These are on the docket projects we are actively working on

-         These are highest priority and cost money to evaluate, move very quickly

-         Other than specific newsworthy updates outside this stage, these are projects we focus on at CEO staff level and AEA

STAGE 1 - Engaged: Coming to market in near future, sellers are contemplating strategic alternatives

-         We spoke with management and know they are looking at potential alternatives

-         Do not have a CIM, likely speaking with bankers but no mandate

-         Soon to be on the table

STAGE 2 – Approaching: We approached the seller and signaled our interest

-         Exploratory stage, collect information as we can (Preliminary research)

-         Very early on research, first steps of reaching out to mgmt

-         If this company did go up for sale, would we be interested?

STAGE 3 - Hold: Likely will be the least commonly used stage

-         Were in the process of selling the business recently

-         For idiosyncratic or macroeconomic reasons, transaction was halted

-         If sale process does not re-engage in near term moves to Stage 4 or Stage 6

STAGE 4 – Long-term Follow-up: Most business we look at are in this bucket (90-95%)

-         We already evaluated the business and did not proceed at the time

-         In theory we are interested but the business is not for sale

-         Not an ongoing project on our end but any information we gather gets collected

STAGE 6 - CLOSED: There is no chance we are buying the business

-         We already completed the sale

-         Someone else recently bought it

-         Too problematic of a business (ownership structure, legal, environmental, etc)

-         The business is no longer a going concern
